wizard.adapter.dora_toggle_desc: DoRA is not a standalone algorithm but an enhancement stacked on the native LoRA route: it decomposes pretrained weights into direction and magnitude and applies the low-rank update to the direction. Verified against this model family's backend pipeline (station-by-station audit complete): native LoRA only — the toggle has no effect on LyCORIS algorithms (the injection chain dispatches LyCORIS before DoRA).
wizard.adapter.dora_toggle_unsupported: DoRA cannot stack on the current algorithm route: the backend ignores the flag (the LyCORIS branch is dispatched before DoRA). Switch to the standard LoRA route first.
wizard.adapter.dora_toggle_family_anima: Anima pipeline caveats: cache-first training consumes cached text conditioning, so no LoRA/DoRA layers are injected into the text encoder (DoRA applies to the DiT only); enabling the Anima memory optimizer (packed forward) rejects DoRA modules and aborts training.
wizard.adapter.dora_toggle_family_newbie: Newbie pipeline caveats: with the default cache-first flow, hitting valid cache artifacts skips text-encoder-side injection (DoRA applies to the DiT only); the text encoder is only injected when caching is off and no cache exists. The adapter type is remapped by the backend onto native injectors; stacking is still controlled by this single switch.
wizard.adapter.dora_toggle_family_flux: FLUX pipeline caveats (backend-verified): both the default unified route and the legacy compatibility trainer accept networks.lora only, CLIP/T5 text encoders stay frozen, and DoRA applies to the transformer only. On this type the dora_wd switch is the single DoRA master entry; the backend normalizes it into the unified training flags.
wizard.adapter.dora_toggle_family_cached: Cache-first DiT pipeline caveats (Krea-2 / Z-Image / Boogu / FLUX.2 / Wan2.2, backend-verified): the text-encoder target list is permanently empty, so DoRA applies to the DiT only; depth expansion exists on the full-finetune route only; on Wan2.2 A14B dual-mount DoRA lands on the primary tower only.
wizard.adapter.tier_base_desc: Pick the base parameterization route: native LoRA, the LyCORIS algorithm family, or other structures.
wizard.adapter.tier_enhance_desc: Enhancements stacked onto the base algorithm without changing the ΔW entity; availability depends on the tier-1 choice.
wizard.adapter.tier_entity_desc: One ΔW entity per linear layer: when several are enabled only the highest-priority one wins and the rest are turned off.
wizard.adapter.mutex_conflict: Conflicts with "{name}": only one entity can be injected per linear layer.
wizard.adapter.restrict.flux_native_lora: FLUX supports the native networks.lora route only: other modules and LyCORIS are rejected by the backend at runtime (RuntimeError), so only standard LoRA is selectable here.
wizard.adapter.restrict.minimax_native_o: MiniMax-H3 accepts standard LoRA only: the backend hard-rejects LyCORIS and DoRA (fail-closed), so those options stay unavailable for this type.
wizard.adapter.restrict.anima_alias_sele: Anima maps underlying modules through its own lora_type alias selector; stack DoRA via the single switch in "Stackable enhancements" instead of looking for a standalone DoRA entry.

validator.gradient_release_turbocore: Gradient Release (Full/Compatible) conflicts with TurboCore; auto-switched to post_step mode. TurboCore requires a global optimizer.step(), while Full/Compatible uses per-parameter optimizer instances.
validator.compile_random_features: torch.compile disables some randomized features (pyramid noise, noise offset, perlin noise, caption dropout, random flip). Turn off torch.compile if you need them.
validator.finetune_small_vram_gradient_r: For full finetune under 24GB VRAM, enable Gradient Release (saves 15-20% VRAM). Recommended: gradient_release_mode = "post_step".
validator.lora_rank_overfit_risk: LoRA rank (network_dim) is {dim}, which may overfit. Recommended: 8-16 for smaller models (Anima/Boogu), 16-32 for larger ones (FLUX).
validator.learning_rate_too_large: Learning rate {lr} is too large and may destabilize training or produce NaN. Recommended: 1e-4 ~ 5e-4 (LoRA), 1e-5 ~ 1e-4 (full finetune).
validator.max_train_steps_too_few: Only {steps} training steps may be too few to learn properly. Recommended: at least 400 steps for LoRA, 1000+ for full finetune.
validator.dora_unstackable_audited: DoRA can only stack on standard LoRA routes ({type} pipeline verified against the backend): base algorithm {base} does not support stacking (the backend ignores this switch), so DoRA has been turned off.
validator.dora_unstackable_pending: DoRA currently only stacks on standard LoRA routes: base algorithm {base} is not on the allow list (the backend ignores this switch), so DoRA has been turned off.
validator.alpha_exceeds_dim: network_alpha ({alpha}) is greater than network_dim ({dim}), which lowers the effective learning rate. Recommended: network_alpha = network_dim / 2 (e.g. dim=16 → alpha=8).
validator.newbie_compile_requires_cache: Newbie's torch.compile needs cache-first training: "use cache pipeline" is currently off and the backend will downgrade the compile plan to off (compile_contract.py:297). Enable caching or switch back to the optimized backend.
validator.compile_blocks_swap_conflict: torch.compile conflicts with Block Swap (blocks_to_swap={blocks}): the backend contract treats it as a conflict (it may error out or silently disable swapping). Pick one: disable compilation or set swap blocks to 0.
validator.h3_swap_requires_unsloth: With H3 Block Swap enabled only Unsloth checkpointing is supported (current: {mode}). It will be reset to unsloth on submit (configs_h3.py:105 hard constraint).
validator.newbie_cache_only_combo: "Cache-only build" and "force rebuild cache" are both on: this run will only rebuild the cache and skip the training loop.
validator.wan22_depth_expansion_variant: Wan2.2 depth expansion only supports the TI2V-5B single tower: the T2V-A14B dual-tower variant rejects expansion. Depth expansion has been turned off.
validator.missing_train_data_dir: Training dataset path is empty; training cannot start.
validator.missing_model_path: Pretrained model path is empty; training cannot start.
validator.anima_short_training_recommend: Short Anima LoRA runs (< 800 steps) recommendations: {recommendations}
validator.save_interval_both_zero: save_every_n_epochs and save_every_n_steps must not both be 0: with both at 0 there is no periodic checkpoint point, so a run that crashes, OOMs, or is stopped manually produces no weights at all. Either value may be 0 (= route off), but then the other must be > 0.
validator.field_rank_too_large: LoRA rank {value} is very high and risks overfitting plus VRAM pressure
validator.field_lr_too_large: Learning rate {value} is very high and may destabilize training
validator.field_lr_too_small: Learning rate {value} is very low; the model may not learn
validator.field_steps_too_few: Only {value} training steps may not be enough to learn
